models.name: Qwen3.5 2B LiteRT
models.description: Experimental: may carry state between chats (one Engine per model) - judge only after a fresh load. Qwen3.5-2B text decoder (int8) as a LiteRT-LM container - 201-language coverage, good Russian for its size; checked by the converter on LiteRT-LM 0.15/0.16. Details: hybrid recurrent model; LiteRT-LM #3165 keeps recurrent state across conversations on a reused Engine, and this app reuses one Engine per loaded model (its warm-up already uses the first conversation).
models.author: Alibaba
models.notes: Pinned to the 2026-10-16 file (CPU arithmetic-loop fix + tokenizer fix), before the 2026-11-09 move to external weights. Manifest min_runtime litert-lm 0.15.0. Galaxy S26: GPU ~19 tok/s (peak 4.22 GB for this graph), CPU ~23 tok/s (peak 3.16 GB). GatedDeltaNet hybrid; first GPU engine init can take 50-90 s. Model card (pinned revision): needs a fresh Engine per conversation (state carry-over on a reused Engine, LiteRT-LM #3165, measured on 0.18.0).

models.name: Qwen3.5 4B Mixed Int4 LiteRT
models.description: Experimental: may carry state between chats (one Engine per model) - judge only after a fresh load. Qwen3.5-4B (mixed INT4) as a LiteRT-LM container - the strongest Russian in the 2-4B range of this catalog; slower than the 2B. Details: hybrid recurrent model; LiteRT-LM #3165 keeps recurrent state across conversations on a reused Engine, and this app reuses one Engine per loaded model (its warm-up already uses the first conversation).
models.author: Alibaba
models.notes: Pinned to the 2026-10-25 revision: tokenizer-fixed file, before the 2026-11-03 qwen3_5 tool-call metadata and the 2026-11-09 external-weights repack. Manifest min_runtime 0.15.0. Galaxy S26 GPU (prebuilt 2026-09-18, not 0.16.0): engine build 73-86 s, correct answer, peak 3.8-4.1 GB, no speed published; CPU int8 8.9 tok/s. Confirm the backend in logcat. Model card (pinned revision): needs a fresh Engine per conversation (state carry-over on a reused Engine, LiteRT-LM #3165, measured on 0.18.0).

models.name: Ministral 3 3B Instruct LiteRT
models.description: Mistral's Ministral-3-3B-Instruct-2512 (text-only, int4 block32) as a LiteRT-LM container - fast GPU chat. Russian is not an officially supported language; treat as English-first until tested.
models.author: Mistral AI
models.notes: Pinned to the 2026-09-21 file (container v1.6.0, chat template accepts string and parts forms): the graph measured on a Pixel 8a with litert-lm 0.16.0 GPU (full delegation, correct answer). The later 2026-10 files (GPU-composite rewrite, then external weights) were not measured on 0.16.0. Runs in the GENERIC (container template) family so the [SYSTEM_PROMPT] block is kept.
